4199116.name: main
4199116.note: console entry: parses options, loads the profile, compiles the pattern, streams matches (references the usage/banner strings)

4220004.name: TSDictionaryList::ReleaseDictionaries
4220004.note: drops one reference on every listed Dictionary in the shared cache and deletes those reaching zero

4220948.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Dictionary
4220948.note: constructor: installs the vtable, copies the path string

4221484.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Load
4221484.note: vtable slot 1. Reads the .tsd header (magic TSD0/TSD1), Huffman table and calibration matrix; builds the 8-bit lookahead decode tables

4223260.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::Unload
4223260.note: vtable slot 2. Frees the calibration matrix and clears the loaded state

4223392.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::EnsureCurrent
4223392.note: vtable slot 3. Reloads when the file's timestamp no longer matches; returns the loaded flag

4223588.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetCounts
4223588.note: vtable slot 10. Sums the per-length count tables into four totals

4223692.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetSummaryText
4223692.note: vtable slot 7. Formats the Headwords / Definitions / Description text

4224296.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetFileDateText
4224296.note: vtable slot 8. Formats the file time with GetDateFormatA

4224872.name: TSDictionaryList::Dictionary::GetDescription
4224872.note: vtable slot 9. Returns the header description string (Dictionary+0x2014)

4231324.name: GetProgramDirectory
4231324.note: GetModuleFileNameA, truncated after the last backslash

4232796.name: ReadFileTime
4232796.note: opens the file read-only and calls GetFileTime

4233820.name: InputEngine::InputEngine
4233820.note: constructor(list, dictionaryIndex): links the engine into the global InputEngine list

4234092.name: InputEngine::StartLength
4234092.note: selects one word-length bucket: looks up word_stream_offsets[L], skips empty buckets, opens the file, clears the word buffer

4234360.name: InputEngine::NextMatch
4234360.note: Huffman-decodes words of the current length (8-bit lookahead table, then bit-by-bit trie walk), at most 2000 per call, testing each against the MatchEngineSet

4235420.name: MatchEngineSet::EvalLogic
4235420.note: boolean VM over the logic bytecode: 1=OR 2=AND 3=END 4=open paren 5=close paren, bit 0x08=NOT. mode 0 = precomputed flags, 1 = length pre-check (NOT is skipped), 2 = match the word. The 0x412000 address in your notes is this function in TEA.exe

4235800.name: InputEngine::OpenFile
4235800.note: CreateFileA + seek to the saved offset; on ERROR_TOO_MANY_OPEN_FILES closes another engine's handle from the global list and retries

4236088.name: InputEngine::GetAnnotation
4236088.note: returns the text following the display word's NUL, or NULL when empty. The 0x4122bc address in your notes is this function in TEA.exe

4236156.name: MatchEngine::CompilePattern
4236156.note: recursive [template][;anagram] parser; mutually recursive with CompileTemplate / CompileAnagram. Not read line by line

4238904.name: MatchEngine::CompileTemplate
4238904.note: template-side compiler (choice lists, escapes per your notes). Role inferred from call structure

4241112.name: MatchEngine::CompileAnagram
4241112.note: anagram-side compiler; uses the Pattern pool. Role inferred from call structure

4244584.name: MatchEngine::Compile
4244584.note: compiles one leaf pattern and selects the fast-path matcher stored at +0x114c

4249016.name: MatchEngine::IsValid
4249016.note: returns the int at +0x1020; MatchEngineSet::Compile treats 0 as a compile failure

4249048.name: MatchEngine::MatchEngine
4249048.note: constructor: Pattern pool, empty bytecode string, shortest=1, longest=100, matcher=MatchGeneral

4249372.name: MatchEngine::SetWordLength
4249372.note: stores the candidate length (+0x113c) and the slack over the template minimum (+0x1140)

4249404.name: MatchEngine::MatchWord
4249404.note: builds the punctuation-prefix and filtered raw buffers when needed, then calls the selected matcher

4249668.name: MatchEngine::FormatBalance
4249668.note: renders the anagram balance table as text. Entry checked; body only skimmed

4249980.name: VariableValues::Bind
4249980.note: binds variable 0..9 to a letter if unbound (0xfe) and, when exclusive, not already used

4250056.name: VariableValues::Get
4250056.note: pointer to the binding slot for one variable

4250084.name: VariableValues::IsLetterBound
4250084.note: true when the exclusive option is on and another variable already holds this letter

4250160.name: VariableValues::Save
4250160.note: copies the ten bindings into a snapshot

4250192.name: VariableValues::Restore
4250192.note: restores the ten bindings from a snapshot

4250232.name: MatchEngine::ResetMatchState
4250232.note: clears the variable-binding flag and the balance flag before a match

4250552.name: Pattern::Add
4250552.note: returns the index of an equal entry or appends (capacity 256)

4250752.name: MatchEngine::MatchFixedTemplate
4250752.note: fast path: (offset, letter) pairs compared in sequence until an opcode >= 0xf0

4250784.name: MatchEngine::MatchDistinctAnagram
4250784.note: fast path for anagrams of distinct letters. Entry checked; body not read

4250900.name: MatchEngine::MatchMultiAnagram
4250900.note: fast path for anagrams with repeated letters. Entry checked; body not read

4251000.name: MatchEngine::RunTemplateVM
4251000.note: backtracking template bytecode interpreter. Entry checked; body not read

4252720.name: MatchEngine::AnagramMultiLetters
4252720.note: anagram opcode 0xf6: (multiplicity, letter) pairs checked against the letter histogram with an omission budget

4252800.name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceLists
4252800.note: anagram opcode 0xf7 solver. Entry checked; body not read

4253040.name: MatchEngine::AnagramChoiceListsOp
4253040.note: fetches the Pattern pool slot and calls AnagramChoiceLists

4253108.name: MatchEngine::AnagramVariables
4253108.note: anagram opcode 0xf8. Entry checked; body not read

4253596.name: MatchEngine::AnagramSubPattern
4253596.note: anagram opcode 0xfa. Entry checked; body not read

4254296.name: MatchEngine::RunAnagramVM
4254296.note: anagram bytecode interpreter. Entry checked; body not read

4254496.name: MatchEngine::ComputeBalance
4254496.note: fills the 256-entry balance table: +1 per candidate letter, minus the letters the anagram consumed

4254700.name: MatchEngine::MatchGeneral
4254700.note: default matcher installed by the constructor; snapshots variable bindings around the template VM

4255164.name: FilterWordByCaseMode
4255164.note: copies a word into a new string under mode 1..4 (all / letters only / letters upper-cased / letters lower-cased)

4256364.name: TEAViewProfileWindows::Load
4256364.note: reads fonts, colours, view settings and the open-dictionary list from the registry profile; class membership inferred from position next to the destructor

4264716.name: ExpandQueryMacros
4264716.note: replaces unescaped @ and # with the configured expansions; \x pairs are copied verbatim

4265328.name: LoadPatternOptions
4265328.note: reads ExpansionAt, ExpansionHash, VariablesExclusive, IgnoreUnusedPunctuation from the registry profile

4266300.name: Persist::Persist
4266300.note: opens or creates the registry key (RegOpenKeyExA / RegCreateKeyExA)

4268108.name: MatchEngineSet::Compile
4268108.note: splits the expanded query on & | ! ( ), creates one MatchEngine per leaf and calls MatchEngine::Compile; returns the first leaf's error status
